summary: Sourced Deoband evidence now covers monsoon flooding of roads and the government hospital, power tripping in the industrial area, and district-level cane dues, while town-level jams, low voltage and bazaar life remain unverified inference.

positives.english: *Darul Uloom's name keeps Deoband known across the country
positives.hindi: *दारुल उलूम से देवबंद की पहचान देश-विदेश तक है
positives.basis: Inference: no source opened for the reputation claim. The Amar Ujala 23 Aug 2026 Deoband report does confirm that Darul Uloom is in Deoband (it names 'दारुल उलूम की सड़कें'), but says nothing about its reputation.

positives.english: Saharanpur's sports college, stalled since 2011, is now complete and admitting athletes
positives.hindi: सहारनपुर का खेल कॉलेज, जो 2011 से अधूरा था, अब बन गया
positives.basis: District-level (Saharanpur city, not Deoband town), dated 1 July 2026: the college, 'pending since 2011', was completed; 80 seats reserved for athletes; 'Its academic session has started from 2026-27.' Free Press Journal, a national outlet.

positives.english: *Local bazaar and shops stay open and busy through the day
positives.hindi: *देवबंद का बाज़ार दिनभर खुला रहता है, दुकानें चलती रहती हैं
positives.basis: Inference: no source opened for this claim; a general town-level impression, not verified.

positives.english: *Students come from far away to study in Deoband's schools
positives.hindi: *दूर-दूर से छात्र यहाँ पढ़ने आते हैं, शिक्षा का नाम है
positives.basis: Inference: no source opened for this claim; linked to the Darul Uloom profile of the town, not verified.

positives.english: *Town is about 150 km from Delhi, reachable by road
positives.hindi: *दिल्ली से करीब 150 किलोमीटर, सड़क से आना-जाना संभव है
positives.basis: Inference: the Wikipedia Deoband page gives the distance from Delhi (about 150 km); 'reachable by road' is not separately verified.

negatives.english: Sugar mills still owe cane growers money, when will payment come?
negatives.hindi: चीनी मिलों पर गन्ना किसानों का बकाया है, पैसा कब मिलेगा?
negatives.basis: District-level (Saharanpur), dated 3 June 2021, verified: mills paid Rs 100.34 crore that day, Deoband mill's share Rs 19 crore, and 'जिले की शुगर मिलों पर अभी भी 630 करोड़ रुपये गन्ना मूल्य के बकाया हैं'. Names the Deoband mill, but the 2021 figure is old; no 2024-2026 Deoband mill dues report was found.

negatives.english: Every monsoon Deoband's roads and drains go under water, residents say
negatives.hindi: बरसात में देवबंद की सड़कें-नाले पानी में डूब जाते हैं
negatives.basis: Deoband town, dated 23 Aug 2026, verified: about one hour of rain flooded main roads including Mohalla Nechalgarh, Bhayla Road, Ravidas Marg, Shikshak Nagar and roads near Darul Uloom; the government hospital on Railway Road had about 2.5 feet of water. Residents said it happens every year and blamed poor pre-monsoon drain cleaning ('बरसात से पहले नालों की उचित सफाई ... नहीं की जाती').

negatives.english: Farmers want cane price of Rs 600 per quintal, or farming won't pay
negatives.hindi: गन्ने का भाव 600 रुपये क्विंटल हो, तभी खेती का गुज़ारा होगा
negatives.basis: District-level (Saharanpur), dated 7 January 2023, verified: BKU (Verma) demanded 'गन्ना मूल्य 600 रुपये प्रति क्विंटल घोषित' in a memorandum to DM Akhilesh Singh. Not Deoband-town-specific; 2023, not 2024-2026.

negatives.english: Factories in Deoband keep facing power tripping, when will a separate feeder come?
negatives.hindi: फैक्ट्रियों में बार-बार बिजली ट्रिप होती है, अलग फीडर कब लगेगा
negatives.basis: Deoband industrial area, dated 21 Sep 2026, verified: Indian Industries Association entrepreneurs in Deoband submitted a memorandum for 'औद्योगिक क्षेत्र के लिए अलग से फीडर'; chapter chairman said factories' load is tied to a nearby colony's supply, so 'ट्रिपिंग की समस्या बनी रहती है'. Industry complaint, not household; household low-voltage complaints for Deoband were not found.

negatives.english: *Encroachment and traffic jams on town roads are a daily trouble
negatives.hindi: *सड़क पर अतिक्रमण और दुकानों के आगे जाम रोज़ की परेशानी है
negatives.basis: Inference: no Deoband-specific source found in 2024-2026 searches. Encroachment-related jam reports were from other UP towns (Siddharthnagar, Muzaffarnagar, Jalaun) and a Saharanpur city bridge jam (Mar 2025, Hindon bridge), not Deoband.

round2.changes: Verified both existing Amar Ujala sources (2021 and 2023 content and dates confirmed, kept) and the Wikipedia identity page (AC 5, Deoband, Saharanpur, reserved None). Replaced inference negative 'drains and water' with sourced Amar Ujala 23 Aug 2026 Deoband flooding report. Replaced inference negative 'low voltage' with sourced Amar Ujala 21 Sep 2026 Deoband industrial-area power tripping report (industry, not household). Replaced inference positive 'municipal water claim' (based on an uncited Wikipedia line) with sourced Saharanpur sports college (Free Press Journal, 1 Jul 2026, district-level). Dropped an unconfirmed Deoband 325-project claim from the same Free Press Journal page (no second source). Re-ranked negatives by likely impact.

notes: Round 2 status: negatives sourced 4 of 5 (3 are Deoband-named or Deoband industry: flooding, power feeder, and the 2021 sugar dues article naming the Deoband mill; cane price is district-level). Positives sourced 1 of 5, and that one is district-level (Saharanpur city sports college), not Deoband. Still inference: Darul Uloom reputation, bazaar, students, Delhi distance, and encroachment/jams. Searches in Hindi and English for Deoband 2024-2026 jams, Deoband mill dues, household low voltage, hospital services, and Deoband completed roads or bridges returned no Deoband-specific reports. The 2026 flood report names the Railway Road government hospital as flooded, but hospital services were not reviewed. Sugar and cane-price sources are 2021 and 2023, outside the 2024-2026 preference. Field check recommended: Deoband Nagar Palika drain cleaning and water supply, Deoband mill 2025-26 dues, UPPCL household voltage complaints, Deoband bazaar traffic and encroachment, and Deoband government hospital status.
